name: Genuine
definition: Normal behaviour: the vehicle broadcasts its real position, speed, acceleration and heading.

name: Constant position
definition: The transmitted position stays constant (frozen) while the vehicle keeps moving.

name: Constant position offset
definition: The transmitted position is the real position plus a fixed offset.

name: Random position
definition: The transmitted position is drawn uniformly at random from the simulation playground in every message.

name: Random position offset
definition: The transmitted position is the real position plus a random offset that changes in every message.

name: Constant speed
definition: The transmitted speed stays constant regardless of the vehicle's real motion.

name: Constant speed offset
definition: The transmitted speed is the real speed plus a fixed offset.

name: Random speed
definition: The transmitted speed is drawn uniformly at random in every message.

name: Random speed offset
definition: The transmitted speed is the real speed plus a random offset that changes in every message.

name: Eventual stop
definition: The vehicle simulates a sudden stop by freezing its transmitted position and setting its speed to zero.

name: Disruptive
definition: The vehicle re-broadcasts data previously received from random neighbouring vehicles as if it were its own.

name: Data replay
definition: The vehicle re-broadcasts data previously received from one specific target neighbour as if it were its own.

name: Delayed messages
definition: Messages contain correct data but are sent with a delay, so the reported state is stale.

name: DoS
definition: Denial of service: the vehicle sends messages at a frequency higher than the limit set by the standard.

name: DoS random
definition: Denial of service in which all message fields are additionally set to random values.

name: DoS disruptive
definition: Denial of service in which the high-frequency messages replay data received from random neighbours.

name: Grid Sybil
definition: Traffic-congestion Sybil attack: the attacker creates a grid of ghost vehicles, each with its own pseudonym.

name: Data replay Sybil
definition: Data replay in which the attacker switches to a new pseudonym for every new target vehicle.

name: DoS random Sybil
definition: DoS random in which the attacker changes its pseudonym on every message.

name: DoS disruptive Sybil
definition: DoS disruptive in which the attacker changes its pseudonym on every message.
